title: fix(lint): connector, permission-set and form-view advisories carry a user sentence in every platform locale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWK5rFW1SUGSkDw9iatZE4f)_

Fixes #32842

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：保存连接器、权限集和表单视图时返回的 3 类提示，现在都带一句面向用户的话，覆盖平台全部 11 种语言；规则 id、英文 message 和 hint 一字未改。卡片列出的另外 7 类提示保存时根本不会返回，本 PR 不为它们写文案，只在下方写明原因。
- **为什么改**：此前这些提示只有给开发者看的英文，非英文界面的管理员保存连接器或权限集时看不懂；这是 #32655 已落地做法在连接器、权限和表单领域的延续。连接器那句只说凭据写在哪个请求头或变量里，绝不包含凭据本身。
- **风险与回滚**：只新增文案和 `userTextParams` 字段，不改变哪些写入被拒、哪些通过；回滚即撤销本 PR。`os validate --json` / `os build --json` 的 warnings 里这三类提示会多出 `userTextParams` 键。
- **先看**：`lint-connector-credential-literals.user-text.ts`（4 种情形，最贴近用户），再看 `validate-predicate-path-refs.user-text.ts`（两种理解都给出写法），最后看 `authoring-rules.ts` 里两行转发。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/finding-user-text.connector-permission-form.test.ts`，21 个用例全绿，每条都从真实元数据经运行时保存门取出并逐语言渲染。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Three advisory rule ids that the save door returns now carry `userTextParams` and a user sentence in all eleven `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS`. Each rule file gets a `*.user-text.ts` catalog beside it, and the three catalogs merge into `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG` through `mergeUserTextCatalogs`, the way #32655 landed `validate-security-posture.user-text.ts`.

| Rule file | Catalog | Id | Write |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lint-connector-credential-literals.ts` | `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIAL_LITERALS_USER_TEXT` | `connector-credential-literal` | connector |
| `validate-retired-permission-residue.ts` | `RETIRED_PERMISSION_RESIDUE_USER_TEXT` | `permission-retired-lifecycle-residue` | permission |
| `validate-predicate-path-refs.ts` | `PREDICATE_PATH_REFS_USER_TEXT` | `predicate-rhs-path-shaped` (bare-word `warning` arm only) | view |

- `connector-credential-literal` has three push sites and four arms, chosen by `position`: `header` and `env` (a literal in one of the four maps; params `connector`, `name`), `credential-env` (a credential typed into `transport.credentialEnv`) and `stdio-auth` (a stdio MCP server whose `auth` reaches nothing); both carry only `connector`. ⛔ No param and no sentence carries the credential value, following the `lint-flow-credential-literals` precedent. The sentences name the console's own page, Connector credentials (`connectorCredentials.title`).
- `permission-retired-lifecycle-residue`: params `permissionSet`, `object`, `key`. The sentence says the line grants nothing, to delete it, and that restore and purge are granted through the recycle bin (`recycleBin.title`).
- `predicate-rhs-path-shaped`: params `view`, `word`, `op`, set on the bare-word arm only; the dotted arm refuses the write and carries none. The view name is threaded through `checkPredicate` / `walkFields` (same file). Per the rule's own note (`validate-predicate-path-refs.ts`, §One position, one prescription: which reading the author meant is not decided), the sentence names both readings and the supported spelling of each (`== 'active'`, or the field on the left: `data.active == 'yes'`) and never prescribes the root in place (`== data.active` is the refused arm).
- `authoring-rules.ts`: the `lintConnectorCredentialLiterals` and `validateRetiredPermissionResidue` adapters rebuilt findings field by field and dropped `userTextParams`; each gets the one-line conditional spread (#33120, #33140 precedent). `validatePredicatePathRefs` passes findings through unchanged.
- Changeset `32842-advisory-user-text.md`, `@objectstack/lint` patch.

## Tests

New `finding-user-text.connector-permission-form.test.ts`, 21 tests, in the shape of `finding-user-text.data-model.test.ts`:

- exact coverage of each catalog (ids × 11 locales) and its identity in `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG`; the seven never-at-door ids have no entry;
- every push site rendered from its real finding in every locale (connector header, env, credentialEnv and stdio-auth; permission `allowRestore` and `allowPurge`; the bare-word predicate), with no `undefined`, no unfilled `${`, every shown name present, and no locale falling back to the English sentence; the four connector arms render apart in every locale;
- no credential sentinel in any param or any locale's sentence;
- both predicate readings in every locale, for `==` and `!=`, and never the root in place; the dotted arm carries no params;
- one runtime-gate case per write type (connector, permission, view) through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, with the advisory's params checked and `userMessage` parsed under `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` (de-DE, ja-JP, fr-FR).

## Acceptance notes

**Re-measure.** The card's table lists 10 ids in 8 files; the static scan matches (each id produces exactly one `warning` whole-stack). Through the save door (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules` on each id's own write type with an objects context, main `a83c3667`), 3 reach a user. This PR writes catalogs and pins for those 3 only. Under #32835's Done-when alternative, the 7 that never reach the door:

- **(a) reference-integrity suite members on its frozen `flow` default.** An agent, app, skill or mapping write dispatches none of them, and a flow write's snapshot carries no agents, apps, skills or mappings. Measured: 0 at the door for each.
  - `agent-authoring-withdrawn`, `default-agent-outside-roster`, `default-agent-legacy-alias` (`validate-ai-agent-authoring.ts`)
  - `mapping-connector-source-unknown` (`validate-mapping-connector-source.ts`)
  - `ai-skill-tool-unresolved` (`validate-ai-tool-references.ts`): kept off the door on purpose by ruling 5791822697 (ADR-0109 Decision §3), since a per-write snapshot cannot resolve a skill's tools truthfully.
- **(b) CLI-only registry entries.**
  - `security-external-owner-unmapped` (`validateExternalOwnerSharing`, `RUNTIME_OBJECT_ADVISORY_VOLUME`)
  - `sharing-rule-object-not-shareable` (`validateSharingRuleEnforceability`, pending a `sharing_rule` door that carries `sharingRules`)

**Agent-written sentences for the native-review round.** Every non-English sentence in this PR is agent-written: 3 ids (6 sentences counting the connector's four arms) × 10 locales (zh-Hans, zh-Hant, es, ar, fr, pt-BR, ru, de, ja, ko), in the three `*.user-text.ts` files above. Terms follow `ui/packages/i18n`: Connector credentials 连接器凭据 / 聯結器憑據 / Credenciales de conectores / بيانات اعتماد الموصلات / Identifiants des connecteurs / Credenciais de conectores / Учётные данные коннекторов / Connector-Zugangsdaten / コネクタ認証情報 / 커넥터 자격 증명; recycle bin 回收站 / 回收站 / papelera / سلة المحذوفات / corbeille / lixeira / корзина / Papierkorb / ごみ箱 / 휴지통; permission set as in `validate-security-posture.user-text.ts`. zh-Hant uses the console's 聯結器 and 回收站, which differ from the flow catalog's 連接器; the native round may want to settle one spelling. The connector `stdio-auth` and the predicate sentences carry the most technical wording and are the best first read.

**Metadata-protocol.** `none`. The #32655 precedent (#32790) declared `added` / `Clause-②: yes` because it added a spec field (`userMessage`, the `api` authorable shard); this PR adds no spec field and moves no shard, so it follows #32835's reading for its lint-only sub-cards (#32836, #32837, #32838 all `none`).

**Ruling grep** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔` across the surface, read before editing): connector credential literals 2 (never the value; stdio needs `credentialEnv`), retired permission residue 3 (director ruling D, not re-adjudicable; table not derived live), predicate path refs 2 (the consumer's ruling on the right side; which reading the author meant is undecided), `finding-user-text.ts` 2, the four never-at-door files 0–2 each (untouched). The sentences keep every one of them; none is reversed.

**Serial.** #32838 (PR #33140) landed on `finding-user-text.ts` and `authoring-rules.ts` while this was in flight; main was merged once and every catalog line and adapter spread from both is kept. #33072's `validate-expressions.ts` and expression entry are untouched.

**Ablations** (source, committed first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 → 0 on disk, each restored to the HEAD blob `9968f378` and verified by hash):

- deleting the `lintConnectorCredentialLiterals` adapter spread: 1 failed / 20 passed, exactly the connector-write gate case;
- deleting the `validateRetiredPermissionResidue` adapter spread: 1 failed / 20 passed, exactly the permission-write gate case.

## Verification

Head `ad51300d`, `c371f044` merged with `origin/main` at `6482c083` (once, after #33140 landed on `finding-user-text.ts`; conflict on the catalog list resolved by keeping both sides; `authoring-rules.ts` auto-merged with all four adapter spreads present). After the merge: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, full `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2` (lock VERDICT exit 0), `packages/runtime/.objectstack` cleared.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 206 files, 8762 tests passed (VERDICT exit 0). Before the merge, at `c371f044`: 204 files, 8732 passed, 5 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0 (includes `check:test-typecheck`, debt held). `node scripts/check-cli-command-ids.mjs`: exit 0. `check:nul-bytes`: exit 0.
- Consumers of the widened finding shape, each its real reading at the merged head:
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (the save door; `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` names these ids): 337 files passed, 7 skipped; 22799 tests passed, 36 skipped.
  - `@objectstack/cli` `test/connector-credential-literal-doors.e2e.test.ts` (nightly tier, integration project, spawns the CLI): 2 tests passed.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `ad51300d` derives 62 families (identical list to `c371f044`); every line run with stdin closed, exit captured before any pipe, all 62 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero). Record: `spec-seat-2/r2026-11-13/out/32842-gates-ran-ad51300d.list`.

<details><summary>Gate readings that were not exit 0 on the first sweep (c371f044)</summary>

- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3: the shallow clone could not reach the pinned fixture commit `621a4876`; after fetching it, exit 0 (and exit 0 in the post-merge sweep).

</details>

- No dogfood battery: the title has no `!` and `Clause-②:` carries no `(narrowing)` arm.
